# ADR-3089: A08: Auto-execute macro content for document pipe 5

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Macros become code execution vectors.

## Decision

Pipelines SHALL NOT auto-execute macro content for document pipe 5 (A08-5).

## Consequences

Documents are sandboxed or converted.
